failed_or_abandoned: First full run (388 new WimPyDD spectra, 833 s) exceeded the 600 s foreground limit and was moved to the background by the harness; the script was made resumable (partial cache + P027_BUDGET_S time budget) and re-run in the foreground (158 s with the completed cache).
O4^v on the fine 10 keV delta grid was dropped (O4 spectra cost ~3 s each; LZ states O4 s/v spectra are indistinguishable; O4^v LZ-grid Bayes factors agree with O4^s within 1 %).
A prior uniform over LZ's own Lagrangian list L1-L20 was not attempted (only 12 of 40 Lagrangians map onto our operator basis); the effect is discussed qualitatively in details.md section 8.
